Contact us

Grow past your plan mid year and nothing stops working. Admissions are never blocked by a billing limit. We will call you about moving up at a sensible moment, not in the middle of admission season. Payment is by bank transfer: there is no card on file and no automatic renewal.

What the price includes

Every module

Fees, attendance, exams and result cards, accounts and payroll, certificates, ID cards, the parent portal and year end rollover. There is no premium tier holding one of them back.

The trial, properly

Fourteen days, no card, and no crippled version. Put one real class in and run a month's challans against your own fee sheet. If the numbers do not agree with your register, do not buy it.

Your data, always

A full export in a plain readable format at any time, including on the day you leave. No lock in and no charge for your own records.

How paying works

  • Bank transfer. There is no card on file and no automatic renewal. An invoice carries our business name, NTN and bank account, so your accounts can file it and withhold what they must.
  • Growing past your plan does not stop anything. Admissions are never blocked by a billing limit. We call you about moving up at a sensible moment, not in the middle of admission season.
  • Stopping payment does not delete your records. The account locks, the export keeps working, and nothing is destroyed on a date we chose.
